title: A Wild Runner turns after its planned straight runway blocks

verification.actor: WILD species 234 (Stantler), acquired through spawn; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Leave the same live Runner Stantler on neutral input until its three-tile planned straight runway blocks and it selects a clear perpendicular turn after two skid tiles
verification.observable: The blocked straight request is ignored. Two eight-frame skid Walks each commit in the original direction, then the perpendicular recovery Walk uses nominal time five plus the exact identity-and-commit keyed variance. Its complete elapsed schedule and third commit are required

setupMutations.change: Teleport only the disposable session's player to map33 (585,406), then spawn a native Stantler at (586,404) and bind its exact identity. Do not change the profile, terrain, input, policy state, direction choice, collision result, or motion during observation.

limits: Prepared spawning does not prove natural population spawning.
This proves one Route 29 blocked-runway turn window, not every terrain shape.
Registration alone is not runtime acceptance; the checked shared test must pass on the current ROM.

events.value: Teleport disposable player to map33 (585,406), then spawn and bind Wild Stantler at (586,404)
Keep input neutral and retain the blocked planned straight request, accepted turn skid, and accepted recovery Walk

stop.condition: The selected Stantler completes the turn skid and post-skid recovery

invariants: The planned three-tile straight corridor is rejected while the two skid tiles and perpendicular exit remain clear

Both eight-frame skid tiles and the exactly keyed recovery each move one tile and commit once
